member.name: T:HashNow.Core.FileHasher
member.summary: High-performance file hasher supporting 70 hash algorithms computed via StreamHash HashFacade.

remarks.para: is the core class for computing cryptographic and non-cryptographic hash values for files and byte arrays. It supports 70 different algorithms via StreamHash's HashFacade, organized into four categories:

item.description: Checksums & CRCs (9): CRC32, CRC32C, CRC64, CRC16 (3 variants), Adler-32, Fletcher-16, Fletcher-32
Fast Non-Crypto (22): xxHash family, MurmurHash3, CityHash, FarmHash, SpookyHash, SipHash, HighwayHash, MetroHash, wyhash, FNV-1a, DJB2, SDBM, LoseLose
Cryptographic (25): MD family, SHA family, SHA-3, Keccak, BLAKE family, RIPEMD family
Other Crypto (14): Whirlpool, Tiger, GOST, Streebog, Skein, Groestl, JH, KangarooTwelve, SM3

remarks.para: All hashing is delegated to StreamHash's HashFacade for consistent implementation.

member.name: T:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult
member.summary: Represents the complete result of hashing a file with all 70 supported hash algorithms.

remarks.para: This class contains all computed hash values organized into four categories:

item.description: Checksums & CRCs (9 algorithms) - Fast error detection
Non-Crypto Fast Hashes (21 algorithms) - High-speed, non-cryptographic
Other Crypto Hashes (14 algorithms) - Specialized cryptographic

remarks.para: All hash values are stored as lowercase hexadecimal strings for consistency and interoperability with standard hash verification tools.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc32
member.summary: Gets the CRC-32 checksum (IEEE 802.3 polynomial).

remarks.para: Output: 8 hex characters (32 bits)
CRC-32 is widely used for error detection in network protocols and file formats like ZIP, PNG, and Ethernet frames.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc32C
member.summary: Gets the CRC-32C checksum (Castagnoli polynomial).

remarks.para: Output: 8 hex characters (32 bits)
CRC-32C uses a different polynomial optimized for hardware acceleration (Intel SSE4.2). Used in iSCSI, SCTP, and ext4 filesystem.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc64
member.summary: Gets the CRC-64 checksum (ECMA-182 polynomial).

remarks.para: Output: 16 hex characters (64 bits)
CRC-64 provides stronger error detection than CRC-32, used in some backup systems and data integrity verification.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Adler32
member.summary: Gets the Adler-32 checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 8 hex characters (32 bits)
Adler-32 is faster than CRC-32 but provides weaker error detection. Used in zlib compression library.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Fletcher16
member.summary: Gets the Fletcher-16 checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 4 hex characters (16 bits)
Fletcher-16 is a simple checksum algorithm providing basic error detection with low computational overhead.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Fletcher32
member.summary: Gets the Fletcher-32 checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 8 hex characters (32 bits)
Fletcher-32 provides better error detection than Fletcher-16 while maintaining simplicity and speed.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc16Ccitt
member.summary: Gets the CRC-16-CCITT checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 4 hex characters (16 bits)
CRC-16-CCITT uses polynomial 0x1021, commonly used in X.25, HDLC, and Bluetooth protocols.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc16Modbus
member.summary: Gets the CRC-16-MODBUS checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 4 hex characters (16 bits)
CRC-16-MODBUS uses polynomial 0x8005 with init 0xFFFF, used in MODBUS industrial communication protocol.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.Crc16Usb
member.summary: Gets the CRC-16-USB checksum.

remarks.para: Output: 4 hex characters (16 bits)
CRC-16-USB uses polynomial 0x8005 with inversion, used in USB protocol error detection.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.FileHashResult.XxHash32
member.summary: Gets the xxHash32 hash value.

member.name: T:HashNow.Core.PerformanceDiagnostics
member.summary: Represents detailed performance diagnostics for hash computation.

remarks.para: This class provides granular timing information for analyzing hash performance across different algorithm categories. It helps identify bottlenecks and compare algorithm speeds.

item.description: FileRead: Time to read file into memory
Checksums: CRC32, CRC32C, CRC64, Adler-32, Fletcher checksums
Cryptographic: SHA family, MD family, BLAKE, etc.
OtherCrypto: Whirlpool, Tiger, GOST, Skein, etc.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.PerformanceDiagnostics.FileReadMs
member.summary: Gets or sets the time spent reading the file into memory (milliseconds).
member.remarks: This represents I/O time before any hashing begins. Depends on storage speed (SSD vs HDD) and file size.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.PerformanceDiagnostics.TotalHashMs
member.summary: Gets or sets the total hash computation time (milliseconds).
member.remarks: This is the time for all 70 algorithms computed in parallel. It's typically less than the sum of individual times due to parallelism.

member.name: P:HashNow.Core.PerformanceDiagnostics.TotalMs
member.summary: Gets or sets the total wall-clock time including I/O and hashing (milliseconds).

member.summary: Gets or sets timing for checksum algorithms (CRC32, Adler-32, Fletcher).

member.summary: Gets or sets timing for fast non-cryptographic hashes (xxHash, MurmurHash, etc.).

member.summary: Gets or sets timing for MD family hashes (MD2, MD4, MD5).

member.name: T:HashNow.Core.StreamingHasher
member.summary: Streaming file hasher using StreamHash's batch API for parallel processing of all 70 algorithms.

remarks.para: This class provides memory-efficient hashing for large files by:

item.description: Reading the file once in chunks (default 1MB)
Feeding each chunk to all hash algorithms simultaneously via batch API
Reporting progress based on bytes read
Using ArrayPool to minimize GC pressure

remarks.para: All 70 algorithms are computed in a single pass through the file using StreamHash's unified batch streaming interface with parallel processing for 8-16x speedup.
